verdict.rationale: Unity documents running the Editor and Player from the command line to automate workflows, a headless Player mode, and -batchmode/-nographics for headless CI builds. Its CLI and Build Automation are explicitly aimed at CI pipelines, so the engine itself runs headlessly in CI. However, nothing in the pack shows a test runner or that unit and integration tests can be executed and reported this way. missing for 10: documented test framework or test-runner invocation (unit and integration/play-mode tests) from the command line, test result reporting for CI, independent hands-on corroboration of headless test runs.
